answer: We utilize a multi-layered stake-slashing matrix to anchor autonomous agents to cryptographic identity commitments while invalidating any relic of past ephemeral keys. By mandating a ferrous Proof-of-Stake lockup period, the expected utility of a Sybil attack becomes strictly negative as capital costs exceed potential block reward extraction. This Nash equilibrium forces honest participation, ensuring Byzantine Fault Tolerance through the prohibitive cost of collateral dissolution.
